blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Military reservists in the Davao region received a much-needed boost to their disaster response capabilities on Wednesday (Oct. 21) as the soldiers respond to the earthquakes and flash floods that recently battered Mindanao. The Latter-day Saints Charities Southeast Asia Inc. handed over a fresh batch of humanitarian assistance and disaster response (HADR) equipment to the Army’s 11th Regional Community Defense Group (11RCDG) at Camp San Gabriel in Mintal, Davao City. The information comes from Maj. Ruben Gadut, 10th Infantry Division spokesman, in a statement on Thursday. Major Gen. Alvin Luzon, 10ID commander, said the new gear will […]...
